adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that Salesforce's CalendarService.ts adds a direct fetch to 'https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token' for token refresh (lines 72-89) without using the refreshOAuthTokens wrapper that other integrations use. Looking at the diff, other calendar services like GoogleCalendarService, Office365CalendarService, ZohoCrmCalendarService, etc. all wrap their refresh token calls with refreshOAuthTokens() to support the APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED feature. The Salesforce implementation bypasses this pattern entirely, which means when credential sharing is enabled, Salesforce credentials won't refresh through the configured parent application endpoint. This is a consistency bug where Salesforce doesn't follow the same pattern established for other integrations in this PR.
